name: quadraticChar_card_card
statement: ringChar F ≠ 2) {F' : Type*} [Field F'] [Fintype F'] [DecidableEq F'] (hF' : ringChar F' ≠ 2) (h : ringChar F' ≠ ringChar F) : quadraticChar F (Fintype.card F') = quadraticChar F' (quadraticChar F (-1) * Fintype.card F)

name: quadraticChar_odd_prime
statement: ringChar F ≠ 2) {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (hp₁ : p ≠ 2) (hp₂ : ringChar F ≠ p) : quadraticChar F p = quadraticChar (ZMod p) (χ₄ (Fintype.card F) * Fintype.card F)
